{{ModBox}}
'''Hata-Satya''' is a [[Weapon Augments#Weapon Augment Mods|Weapon Augment Mod]] for {{Weapon|Soma Prime}} that increases [[Critical Chance]] on every hit, until Soma Prime is [[reload]]ed or [[holster]]ed. The critical chance bonus is capped at '''500%''' at all mod ranks.

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! Critical chance
! Hits required to reach 500% critical chance
! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || 0.2% || 2,500 || 2
|-
| 1 || 0.4% || 1,250 || 3
|-
| 2 || 0.6% || 834 || 4
|-
| 3 || 0.8% || 625 || 5
|-
| 4 || 1% || 500 || 6
|-
| 5 || 1.2% || 417 || 7
|}

==Acquisition==
Hata-Satya can be obtained by reaching '''Rank 4 - Friend''' with the [[Entrati]] and purchased for {{Sc| 20,000}} from [[Father]].

==Notes==
*Hata-Satya is additive with similar mods. For example, a max rank, max bonus Hata-Satya and {{M|Point Strike}} will have a {{Math|30% {{mul}} (1 + 500% + 150%)|t=y|p=y}} critical chance.
*Additional hits from [[Multishot]] and [[Punch Through]] also count towards the bonus.
*Bonus damage instances from {{A|Toxic Lash}} and {{A|Xata's Whisper}} count as one extra hit.
*Swapping to [[Soma Incarnon Genesis|Incarnon Form]] counts as reloading the Soma Prime and will therefore end the bonus.
*Using [[melee]], [[Parazon]] mercy finishers, or activating an [[Exalted Weapon]] ability are counted as holstering the Soma Prime and will therefore end the bonus.
*Bonus ends as soon as the reload animation begins or when using {{M|Blood Forge}}.
*Hits against invulnerable enemies, including {{A|Blood Altar}} and {{A|The Lost|Gaze}}, do count toward the bonus.
*Hits against [[Damage/Object|Object]]-class health, barrier-like entities (Arctic [[Eximus]] snow globes and [[Nullifier Crewman|Nullifier]] bubbles), and enemies "converted" into allies ({{A|The Lost|Accuse}}, {{A|Mind Control}}, {{A|Enthrall}}, and {{A|Parasitic Link}}), do '''not''' count toward the bonus.

==Trivia==
*The name of this mod might come from Sanskrit. '''Hata''' means ''killed'', '''Satya''' means ''truth''.{{cite}}

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|33.5}}
*Soma Prime’s Incarnon Form fire now triggers the “Hata-Satya” Augment Mod’s Critical Chance buff.

{{ver|29.1}}
*Fixed the Soma Prime's Hata-Satya Mod not respecting Multishot for Clients.

{{ver|29.0.8}}
*Fixed certain Warframe abilities (Mesa's Shattered Shield, Mag's Magnetize) that create reflecting bullets counting towards hits that increase the Hata-Satya Critical Chance buff. Only hits performed by Soma Prime should increase the Hata-Satya Critical Chance buff.
*Fixed cases where the Hata-Satya Mod HUD buff may remain on screen, and not resetting if you enter bleedout in the middle of a casting animation.

{{Ver|29.0}}
*Introduced
}}

{{ModBox}}
'''Zazvat-Kar''' is a [[Weapon Augments#Weapon Augment Mods|Weapon Augment Mod]] for {{Weapon|Akstiletto Prime}} that increases [[Ammo Efficiency]] by 75% while airborne.

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! Ammo Efficiency
! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || 12.5% || 2
|-
| 1 || 25% || 3
|-
| 2 || 37.5% || 4
|-
| 3 || 50% || 5
|-
| 4 || 62.5% || 6
|-
| 5 || 75% || 7
|}

==Acquisition==
Zazvat-Kar can be obtained by reaching '''Rank 4 - Friend''' with the [[Entrati]] and purchased for {{Sc|20,000}} from [[Father]].

==Notes==
*Stacks multiplicatively with [[Energized Munitions]] for {{Math|1- (1 - 75%) {{mul}} (1 - 75%)|t=y|p=y}} ammo efficiency.
*Stacks additively with the Arcane, {{Arcane|Akimbo Slip Shot}} to give 100% ammo efficiency.
**A rank 1 {{Arcane|Akimbo Slip Shot}} will be enough to reach 100% ammo efficiency with this mod equipped.
*Does ''not'' trigger on [[Landscape]]s while in [[Archwing]] mode.

==Tips==
*{{WF|Zephyr}} synergizes well with this mod, as she can stay hovering with toggled {{A|Tail Wind}}.

==Trivia==
The name is likely of Sanskrit origin, with ''Zazvat'' (शश्वत्) meaning ever, and Kar, shortened from ''Kara'' (कर) possibly meaning tax, toll, or tribute.

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|{{Ver|29.0}}
*Introduced

'''Damzav-Vati''' is a [[Weapon Augments#Weapon Augment Mods|Weapon Augment Mod]] for {{Weapon|Akbronco Prime}} that adds {{D|Viral}} damage.

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! {{D|Viral}} Damage
! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || +40% || 2
|-
| 1 || +80% || 3
|-
| 2 || +120% || 4
|-
| 3 || +160% || 5
|-
| 4 || +200% || 6
|-
| 5 || +240% || 7
|}

==Acquisition==
Damzav-Vati can be obtained by reaching '''Rank 4 - Friend''' with the [[Entrati]] and purchasing it for {{Sc|20,000}} from Father.

==Notes==
*The {{D|Viral}} damage from this mod is added after other modded elements, allowing combinations that otherwise are only possible via innate damage types.
**For example, {{M|Pathogen Rounds}} will not combine with the augment and instead adds {{D|Toxin}} damage.

==Trivia==
*This is the first non-[[Riven Mods|Riven]] mod that innately provides a secondary elemental damage type.
*The name is likely of Sanskrit origin, with Damzav, possibly shortened from ''Damsavisa'' (दंशविष) meaning venom, and ''Vati'' (वाति) possibly meaning to blow, injure, or hurt someone.

'''Bhisaj-Bal''' is a [[Weapon Augments#Weapon Augment Mods|Weapon Augment Mod]] for {{Weapon|Paris Prime}} that restores health every 3 [[Status Effect|Status Effects]], and increases status chance.

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! Health restored
! Status chance
! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || 50 || 15% || 2
|-
| 1 || 100 || 30% || 3
|-
| 2 || 150 || 45% || 4
|-
| 3 || 200 || 60% || 5
|-
| 4 || 250 || 75% || 6
|-
| 5 || 300 || 90% || 7
|}

==Acquisition==
Bhisaj-Bal can be obtained by reaching '''Rank 4 - Friend''' with the [[Entrati]] and purchased for {{Sc| 20,000}} from [[Father]].

==Notes==
*The number of status effects accumulated is shown as a buff.
*Multiple status effects from [[Multishot]] or [[Punch Through]] will count towards the buff.
**Multiple status effects in one hit, from having over 100% Status Chance, will only count as 1 effect for Bhisaj-Bal.

==Trivia==
The name is likely of Sanskrit origin, with ''Bhisaj'' (भिषज्) meaning medicine, doctor, healer; or healing, curing as an adjective. Bal is possibly shortened from ''Bala'' (बल) meaning power or force, or ''Bali'' (बलि) meaning tax, or victim.

*May be sold by [[Acrithis]] for 10 {{Resource|Pathos Clamp}} on a daily rotational basis, requiring [[Drifter/Intrinsics|Drifter Intrinsics]] [[Drifter/Intrinsics/Opportunity|Opportunity]] Rank 9 for the Arcanes to appear in her shop.
